title: Logo Animator — offline deterministic logo generator with animated preview

requirements.summary: Single-page UI to enter a logo description and generate a logo with loading/error states and static preview
acceptanceCriteria: The page contains a multiline text input labeled in English (e.g., "Describe your company and the vibe of the logo") and a primary action to generate a logo.
When generation is running, the UI shows a clear loading state and prevents duplicate submissions.
If generation fails, an English error message is shown with an option to retry.
After success, a static logo preview is displayed without requiring a page refresh.

file_operations.description: Create the single-page layout and core UI: description multiline input, Generate action, loading/disabled state, error with Retry, and a static logo preview panel. Use shadcn-ui components (e.g., Button, Textarea, Card/Alert) to ensure consistent UI states. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Add a focused preview component that renders the generated SVG at multiple sizes (e.g., small + large) to demonstrate crisp scaling, and shows basic metadata (derived wordmark) in English. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.
Create a hook that manages generate() lifecycle (idle/loading/success/error), prevents duplicate submissions while loading, and exposes retry() using the same description.
Ensure the app renders the new single-page App component and retains existing providers (React Query + InternetIdentityProvider).

requirements.summary: Deterministic offline logo generator that produces a structured spec and renders a clean SVG with mark + derived wordmark
acceptanceCriteria: Given the same description, the generated logo output is the same across runs (deterministic).
Logo generation does not call any external services; it runs fully in the frontend.
The generator produces an SVG logo that includes at least: a mark (icon/shape) + a wordmark text element derived from the description (e.g., extracted/guessed company name or first meaningful words).
The SVG scales crisply at different sizes (e.g., small preview and larger preview) without raster artifacts.

file_operations.description: Implement a deterministic, offline generator that converts description text into a LogoSpecification-like object (colors, shapes, style) using a seeded hash/PRNG, and derives a wordmark from the description (e.g., first meaningful words). No network calls.

Implement a pure renderer that converts the structured logo specification + wordmark into a clean, accessible SVG string/React element using vector primitives (paths/shapes/text) so it scales crisply.
Add a small deterministic hashing + seeded PRNG utility used by the generator to guarantee stable outputs across runs for the same input.
Wire the generator + static SVG renderer into the generation hook so the UI receives both the structured spec and the rendered SVG (and derived wordmark) deterministically.

requirements.summary: Animated logo preview derived from the same spec with play/pause and speed control
acceptanceCriteria: An "Animated preview" area is shown after a logo is generated.
The animation can be played/paused via a control in the UI.
A speed control (e.g., slider) changes the animation timing in real time.
The animated logo uses the same colors/shapes/typography as the static SVG (no unrelated second design).

file_operations.description: Create an animated SVG renderer that uses the same logo specification (colors/shapes/wordmark) and applies subtle animations (e.g., draw-in stroke, scale/float) with timing controlled by an external duration/speed value.

Add an Animated preview panel that renders the animated SVG and provides controls: Play/Pause toggle and Speed slider. Use shadcn-ui components (e.g., Button, Slider) for controls. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.
Show the "Animated preview" section after generation, wire play/pause and speed state into AnimatedLogoPreview, and ensure the animated view stays visually consistent with the static preview.

requirements.summary: Signed-in user project persistence UI: save generated projects and list/reopen "My logos"
acceptanceCriteria: When a user is authenticated, generating a logo saves a new project record in the backend.
The UI shows a "My logos" list for the signed-in user, displaying at least description snippet and creation time.
Selecting an item from the list restores the static and animated previews for that project.
Data returned for a user only includes that user’s saved projects.

file_operations.description: Implement a Login/Logout button using the authorization component guidance (useInternetIdentity + React Query cache clearing on logout). Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Add a first-login profile setup dialog (asks for name in English) that uses getCallerUserProfile/saveCallerUserProfile to avoid showing principal IDs. Use shadcn-ui Dialog/Form controls. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Create a React Query hook following the authorization guidance to fetch getCallerUserProfile with proper actor dependency handling to prevent profile-setup modal flash. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Create React Query hooks for authenticated project flows: load the signed-in user's logo projects list and save a new generated project when authenticated (using backend actor methods). Handle authorization failures with user-friendly English messaging.

Create a "My logos" panel that is shown only when authenticated, listing projects with description snippet + creation time, and allows selecting one to restore static + animated previews. Use shadcn-ui list/table primitives (e.g., Card, Button). Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Wire authentication UI (LoginButton), profile setup gating (ProfileSetupDialog), and the "My logos" panel. On successful generation: if authenticated, trigger save to backend and update the list; when selecting a saved logo, restore previews from the saved specification.

requirements.summary: Export generated logo as downloadable SVG and PNG rendered client-side from the SVG
acceptanceCriteria: After generation, the UI provides a download action for SVG.
After generation, the UI provides a download action for PNG at a reasonable default size (e.g., 1024x1024) rendered from the SVG client-side.
Downloaded files open correctly in common viewers/editors (SVG in browser/vector editor; PNG in image viewer).

file_operations.description: Add utilities to download text content as a file (SVG) and to convert an SVG string into a PNG via an offscreen canvas at a default size (e.g., 1024x1024), then download the resulting blob.

Add export UI that appears after generation with actions for Download SVG and Download PNG. Use shadcn-ui Buttons and disabled states where appropriate. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.
Wire ExportButtons into the post-generation UI state, passing the current rendered SVG string and a sensible filename derived from the wordmark.

requirements.summary: Creative-tool oriented visual theme applied consistently across the app UI
acceptanceCriteria: The app uses a consistent color palette, typography scale, and spacing system across input, buttons, panels, previews, and lists.
The theme is clearly creative-tool oriented (e.g., light canvas background, subtle grid/texture, bold accent color) and does not rely on default unstyled components.
All user-facing text is in English.

file_operations.description: Define the global theme tokens (CSS variables used by Tailwind/shadcn), base typography, and a creative-tool canvas styling. Reference the generated background asset at frontend/public/assets/generated/app-bg.dim_1920x1080.png for the app backdrop.

Apply the theme consistently via layout structure (header/tool panels/preview canvas), ensure all labels/help/error text are English, and incorporate the generated app icon asset for branding using frontend/public/assets/generated/app-icon.dim_512x512.png.
Add the generated image asset: Abstract creative-tool background pattern, subtle grid with soft shapes. Ensure it is used as a static frontend asset.
Add the generated image asset: Minimal monochrome app icon featuring a geometric mark. Ensure it is used as a static frontend asset.
Wire the generated app icon at frontend/public/assets/generated/app-icon.dim_512x512.png into the document metadata (e.g., favicon/app icon) to align with the cohesive theme.
